role: Enum state machine of the collector recording lifecycle (idle, streaming(target), overnightStreaming, deviceRecording, paused(id), analyzing, awaitingAcceptance) with a description used in logs and the persisted recording state; the doc lists the transitions the code makes.
types: RecordingPhase: enum — recording lifecycle state, Equatable, CustomStringConvertible

units.does: String form of the phase: 'idle', 'streaming(Ns)', 'overnightStreaming', 'deviceRecording', 'paused(<8-char id>)', 'analyzing', 'awaitingAcceptance'. Stored as PersistedRecordingState.phase and interpolated into logs.
